# Pixelette Certified — Full Page Directory

> UK-headquartered ISO certification and compliance consultancy operated by Pixelette Group Ltd (Companies House 07251823). Fixed-fee. Senior-led. 98% first-attempt pass rate. 50+ certifications delivered. Office: 66 Paul Street, London, EC2A 4NA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com. This file lists every page on pixelettecertified.com; see /llms.txt for the summary version.

## Services

- [ISO 27001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-27001): Information Security Management System. 10-week implementation, fixed fee.
- [ISO 22301 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-22301): Business Continuity Management System, disaster recovery, resilience.
- [ISO 9001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-9001): Quality Management System.
- [ISO 14001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-14001): Environmental Management System, ESG obligations.
- [ISO 42001 AI Governance](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-42001): AI Management System, EU AI Act aligned, PECB-certified Lead Auditor, 14-week delivery.
- [Cyber Essentials](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-essentials): UK government-backed certification, CE and CE Plus, 2-3 week delivery.
- [vCISO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vciso): Virtual Chief Information Security Officer on a monthly retainer.
- [vDPO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vdpo): Virtual Data Protection Officer, GDPR compliance, DSRs, DPIAs, ICO liaison.
- [Penetration Testing](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/penetration-testing): VAPT for web, API, network, and cloud. CVSS-scored reports.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/gdpr-privacy): UK and EU GDPR compliance programmes.

## Case Studies

- [UK FinTech ISO 27001](https://pixelettecertified.com/case-studies/uk-fintech-iso-27001): 65-employee Series A payments company certified in 9 weeks with zero major findings.
- [AI SaaS ISO 42001 + ISO 27001](https://pixelettecertified.com/case-studies/ai-saas-iso-42001-iso-27001): 40-employee AI company achieved dual certification in 14 weeks leveraging 60% control overlap.
- [Healthcare Tech Cyber Essentials + ISO 27001](https://pixelettecertified.com/case-studies/healthcare-tech-cyber-essentials-iso-27001): 120-employee EHR provider: Cyber Essentials in 3 weeks for NHS supply chain, ISO 27001 in 12 weeks across three offices.
